raw.rationale: Trametinib is a potent allosteric MEK1/2 inhibitor whose antiproliferative/cytotoxic activity is strongly enriched in BRAF- or RAS-pathway-mutant lineages, especially melanoma/skin and some lung, colorectal, and thyroid contexts, while most other lineages are relatively insensitive at 2.5 µM in 5-day PRISM assays. Published PRISM/CTRP data show selective sensitivity mainly in skin (melanoma) and subsets of lung, colorectal, and urinary tract lines, with low selectivity probabilities elsewhere.
